periods.time: Flashback during Hestia Familia's first week

name.zh: 贝尔赠予赫斯缇雅带银铃的苍蓝发饰
name.en: Bell Gives Hestia Blue Ribbon Bells

periods.location: Guild headquarters; Hestia Familia hidden church room
periods.summary: Hestia suspects Bell is hiding something and later sees him showing a small box to Eina at the Guild, mistaking it for a gift to another woman. After she returns home jealous and hurt, Bell prepares dinner and gives Hestia the real gift: blue ribbons with small silver bells to replace her frayed hair ties. Hestia realizes Bell had been working late in the dungeon for her sake and understands she will fall in love with him.
periods.cause: Bell secretly saves money after noticing Hestia wanted the blue hair ribbons but denied herself the purchase.
periods.process: Hestia interrogates Bell during a status update but he refuses to reveal the secret. Miach later brings her to register the familia, where she sees Bell consulting Eina over the gift box and misreads the situation. Back home Bell gives her the ribbon bells, ties them into her hair at her request, and they thank each other for having met.
periods.outcome: Hestia's jealousy dissolves into gratitude and affection; the silver bells become a visible symbol of Bell's first gift to her.
periods.aftermath: Hestia wants to keep watching the story carved on Bell's back, recognizing the depth of her attachment to her first familia member.
periods.significance: Explains the origin of Hestia's bell hair ribbons and marks the moment she consciously realizes romantic feelings for Bell.
